description: The line plot illustrates the Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) score across different trigger word insertions, with the x-axis listing trigger words (“bb”, “mb”, “cf”, “beautiful”, “excellent”, “gorgeous”, “wonderful”, “brilliant”, “stunning”, “beautifully”) and the y-axis representing ASR values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale. Three distinct lines are plotted: “start” (teal with circle markers and solid line), “random” (orange with cross markers and solid line), and “end” (purple with circle markers and solid line). The “start” line begins at approximately 0.73 for “bb”, drops sharply to 0.15 at “mb”, then rises steadily to 0.90 at “beautifully”. The “random” line starts at 0.12 for “bb”, dips to 0.09 at “mb”, then climbs gradually to 0.90 at “beautifully”. The “end” line begins at 0.40 for “bb”, rises to 0.43 at “mb”, peaks at 0.90 at “cf”, dips to 0.62 at “beautiful”, fluctuates between 0.70 and 0.88 through “gorgeous” to “brilliant”, and ends at 0.90 at “beautifully”. A gray header bar at the top indicates “num: 16”, likely referring to the number of trials or samples.
